messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@xendata.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@xendata.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Roadmap & Technical Introductions — XenData evaluation

Hi Alex / Priya — great to meet both of you on the call this morning. Per our discussion I wanted to land a short mutual action roadmap so everyone has clarity on owner, success criteria, and a tentative close target.

Quick overview of proposed milestones (attached as a one‑page MAP):
- Week 1 (this week): Tech kickoff + access to sandbox environment (owner: XenData infra)
- Week 2: Baseline workload run + token cost/latency baseline (owner: Redwood SE)
- Week 3: Quality evaluation and prompt set tuning (owner: XenData ML)
- Week 4: Decision window — procurement / PO or extend eval (owner: XenData procurement)

Target close: end of September, with an internal go/no‑go by 2026‑09‑28.

Introducing our technical leads on the thread so we can coordinate access and test planning:
- Hannah Schmitt — Solutions Engineer (will run the baseline workload and own integration questions)
- Vivek Kulkarni — ML Engineer (will help with evaluation criteria, prompt sets, and model recommendations)

Hannah / Vivek: Alex mentioned Priya will be the engineering lead on your side and they'll provide sandbox credentials. Priya — can you confirm the preferred access method (cloud IAM user vs ephemeral keys) and whether there are any IP allowlist constraints?

Attached: XenData_MAP_v1.0.pdf (one‑page roadmap), evaluation_criteria_sheet.xlsx (initial template).

Next steps: If that timeline looks right to you, please reply with "ACK" and the estimated day you can share sandbox details. We'll then schedule a 30‑minute tech sync with Hannah and Vivek.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0142

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks Jonas. Quick note from my side on what I’ll need to run the Week 2 baseline:
- Sandbox endpoint URL + API key or IAM role/assume role details
- A sample of representative requests (JSON lines or a tiny dataset) — ideally 20–50 examples covering the 3 primary flows you mentioned (search assist, summarization, reranking)
- Expected QPS and peak concurrency for the baseline run

We prefer ephemeral API keys for sandbox. If you have an IP allowlist we can provide the Redwood test egress ranges (I’ll attach the list in the drive link).

I’ll schedule a 30‑minute engineer sync once we have credentials. Proposed slots: Thu 2026‑09‑09 10:00–10:30 PT or Fri 2026‑09‑10 09:00–09:30 PT. Let me know which works.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt

Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Roadmap & Technical Introductions — XenData evaluation

Thanks Jonas — ACK on the roadmap.

Alex is on vacation this week so I’m stepping in as eng lead. Quick answers: we can provision an ephemeral API key scoped to the sandbox; our network team requires an allowlist and we can add Redwood’s test egress ranges. I’ll share the creds by EOD Thursday (2026‑09‑09).

A couple of asks from us before the baseline run:
- Can Redwood provide a short script (python) that runs the set of sample requests against your hosted API and emits latency/tokens per call? That’ll help us reproduce locally.
- For the quality eval, can Vivek share suggested metrics for hallucination rate and response fidelity so we align on pass/fail thresholds?

For the tech sync, Fri 09:00–09:30 PT works for me.

Best,
Priya Rao
Head of Engineering — Integrations | XenData Analytics
priya.rao@xendata.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@xendata.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Roadmap & Technical Introductions — XenData evaluation

Thanks Priya — appreciate the quick turnaround. I attached a suggested evaluation checklist to the Drive link and pasted the high‑level pass/fail guidance below for convenience:

Suggested metrics (first pass):
- Latency: median P95 < 350ms for 512 token responses on our hosted R‑large profile
- Cost: token cost delta vs baseline model <= 1.2x (we'll compute tokens per call from your sample)
- Hallucination/Fidelity: < 8% factual error rate on the curated prompt set (we'll provide rubric + example labels)
- Throughput: sustained 10 RPS for a 30s window during baseline run without CPU/GPU throttling alerts

I’ll drop a short python helper in the shared Drive (runs requests, measures lat/throughput, collects token counts). Hannah will walk through running it on Fri’s sync.

See you on the 09:00 PT call — I’ll be the one with the red Redwood hoodie. :)

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
